first.rationale: Prioritize verification of onboarding simplification because it directly addresses both declining completion and activation, with a potentially durable path to qualified revenue. Verify promotional pricing as the consequential alternative given the competitive pricing shock, while guarding against margin, retention, and lead-quality risks. Run a small guarded onboarding test because the current causes of the declines are not yet established.

final.rationale: Run a controlled onboarding-simplification experiment. Verified evidence shows shortened onboarding increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing both current completion and activation declines with evidence of durable downstream value. Promotional pricing is not selected: its verified retention decline makes it unsuitable for the stated long-term qualified-revenue objective despite competitive pressure. Track activation, qualified conversion, 30-day retention, and revenue quality alongside completion to ensure simplification does not reduce qualification.
